answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via synchronized memory-bandwidth attestation. Verifiers issue a simultaneous, identity-bound task, such as simulating a volumetric nebula or fluid flow over a reef mesh, requiring a deterministic state hash within a tight time delta, checked via spot audits. Because concurrent runs saturate VRAM bandwidth, attackers must provision dedicated GPU hardware and power per identity. However, network jitter can delay honest remote nodes past the cutoff.
